# relationship party

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:relationshipParty`](gmeow-relationshipParty.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/relationshipParty>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)

An agent who is one of the parties to an interpersonal relationship. Non-functional: a relationship typically binds two parties (and is left open for group ties).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
